items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: that's how I met Michael F?, Ross Gorman and Henry Buzzy, all those guys... Paul Whiteman had his whole band. He had already arranged for them to set up a table for us.

ctx.x: YOU NEVER HEARD OF ANY OTHER, NOW WHERE DOES THE PART WITH PAUL WHITEMAN COME IN. DID WHITEMAN COME DOWN THERE.

Yeah, see we had been at the Adolphis I guess about six months and Paul Whiteman came in and that was one of the greatest moments of my life. When we came off the bandstand, he came over and he shook my hand and said you're quite a young man on that trombone. I thought that was the greatest thing. Everybody in those days looked upon Paul Whiteman almost as a god really. He said, I'm going to have the whole band come in and hear you fellows. And sure enough, that's how I met Michael F?, Ross Gorman and Henry…
